description: CFE, the Conceptual Functional Equivalent model, is NOAA's simplified rainfall-runoff model designed to represent functions of the U.S. National Water Model. The repository includes a Basic Model Interface version for standalone use or coupling to atmospheric forcing and potential-evapotranspiration modules. Inputs are local forcing series, conceptual water-balance parameters and configuration files; outputs are simulated catchment runoff and model states at the configured time step. Geography is set by the catchment and forcing chosen by the user; no universal grid or period is embedded in the code. NOAA publishes the source freely under Apache-2.0 with build, configuration and test examples. The README distinguishes its original non-BMI code from the expanded interface. A limit is that being functionally equivalent does not make CFE a calibrated copy of every National Water Model process or basin. It can support catchment flow and flood simulations and tests of model coupling. The catalogue's model-noaa-national-water-model is the larger national framework this simplified model relates to. The examples were inspected, not run.
